dimensions.note: One pattern recurs across all four readings, with rivals tested in each: Yumeno converts access, advice and other people's words into an account organized around her own pleasure or desired intimacy, while also valuing work and particular people. B0205 states it as its cumulative finding: an admitted advice pretext (B:P1-P2) and general advice turned into a claimed manager endorsement (D:P3-P4), beside an egalitarian objection to ranked photos (C:P3), a quality standard for her comic (D:P1-P2) and a defended solitary reading (F). B0232 case 21 has her apologize for excitement and then continue appraising younger members and invite the manager to join (P1-P2). B0239 has her claim unlimited looking and touching, take up the correction, then single out QOP's formation as her most important encounter (P23-P28). B0247 has her read a musical proposal as a date and wedding, a compliment as a confession, and Ferb's musical liking as love, while also showing real guitar purchase and practice from a fictional model (CL-B0247-019, -022, -042, -055). The pattern is established for these addressed occasions. The readings refuse both a universal-kindness and a total-insincerity model, and the pattern supplies no operational procedure for an unshown situation.

The readings forbid ordering the ten occurrences or reading them as reform. B0205 explicitly refuses to treat its cases as later reform of earlier boundary failures, and B0239's thanks is meaningful without accomplishing moral rehabilitation. B0247 tracks a sequence inside one family only (proposal, preparation, elided live, renewed invitation) and is not placed against the others or against Main. Earlier Yumeno readings are not curated. No developmental arc or state change across occurrences can be assessed.

Located register evidence is local: the B0232 title kaomoji (ｷﾀ━(ﾟ∀ﾟ)━!), the address 支配人 (B0239 P3, P24-P28), the collective おにゃのこ達 (B0239 attribution), a playful reproach of the manager as mean (B0239 P24), and in B0247 written laughter, a written scream, kiss-like syllables, imitative guitar sound words, a death-tomorrow idiom and a printer-threat idiom (505016902 P19-35; 505016904 P17-33, P43-48, P62-68; CL-B0247-030, -053). The readings paraphrase most of her Japanese, so sentence endings and self-reference are largely absent. All voice cues are unheard, and B0247 leaves some cues unresolved.

Ordinary activities are documented across all four readings, mostly as her own reports: a shared bath reported (B0205 A), booklet shopping in Akiba Seven (C), work on a comic for a manga-club bulletin (D), cloth shopping with Rishuri and Ayumu for a maid costume (E), a rainy day at home with a book borrowed from Kazumi (F), and a yuri manga read until dawn that made her miss Rena's competition (G). B0239 shows her remembering peers' birthdays (P1-P5) and asking about handing over her own booklet (P10-P22). B0247 adds reported festival-period manuscript exhaustion (505016903 P6-19) and enacts a costume-room discussion and an instrument-shop visit in which she chooses by appearance (505016902; 505016904 P0-16; CL-B0247-033, -040). These answer bounded canon questions about these occurrences. Most activities are reported, and the B0247 scenes are occasioned by a work task.

Three readings give a silent addressee, the manager (支配人), whose compliments, questions, advice and one correction come only through her uptake (B0205, B0232, B0239). Peers enter by report: Rishuri and Ayumu as assigned makers, Haru's costume as off-limits (B0205 E:P3-P5), Kazumi as a lender, Rena, Kyoko and Honoka as people she wanted to watch (F, G), and younger members as unnamed objects of appraisal (B0232). B0239 adds differentiated written greetings, including Shizuka's caution and Miwako's question to Hime, and her singling out of QOP. B0247 gives a speaking counterpart, Ferb, whose agreement, aesthetic care, coffee offer, musical recognition, no-hug objection and wife denial are each analyzed against Yumeno's conduct (CL-B0247-021, -035, -046, -050, -054), plus Player's corrections. Differentiation is located for these counterparts in these occurrences only, and the readings stress that others' uptake is mostly unshown.

Interior states are spoken self-reports: frustration at not finding a comic idea (B0205 D:P1-P2), regret at missing the competition (G), surprise at her own celebration and overwhelming happiness at messages addressed to her, with too much information to digest (B0239 P1-P22), barely remembering past festivals and exhaustion before them (B0247 505016903 P6-19), and extravagant happiness at being called cute (505016902 P19-27). B0247 does not show whether she understood Ferb's musical clarification (CL-B0247-049). No narrated interiority beyond her speech is supplied, and voiced delivery is unheard.

Located friction involving Yumeno is brief and largely comic. In B0205 she objects to the manager's apparent suspicious look and defends her solitary reading (F:P2-P5) and objects to ranked photo prices (C:P3). In B0239 she calls the manager mean after his no-unlimited-touching correction and then thanks him (P23-P25). In B0247 Ferb passes over her festival proposal (505016903 P20-24), refuses the hug twice while Yumeno answers with kiss-like syllables (505016904 P43-48), denies the wife claim and questions the claimed vow (505016905 P28-37; CL-B0247-050). The readings analyze her persistence against a stated limit, not a dispute process or a repair.

Only local normative positions are located. In B0205 she objects that ranking Nanasta members by price is unacceptable (C:P3), treats Haru's maid outfit as exclusively Haru's (E:P5), admits that her advice role is a pretext (B:P1-P2) and repairs appreciating to watching the competition (G:P5). In B0232 she apologizes for excitement and then continues the appraisal (P1-P2). In B0239 she takes up the correction that touching is not unlimited before renewing her affection (P23-P30). The readings treat these as positions and uptakes, not deliberation, and none shows a weighed choice.

A comic register recurs across all four readings, and each reading tests it against its costs. B0205 has her accept the manager's old-man joke (B:P3), dismiss her own photo's price because she has a mirror (C:P4) and use ascension language for a costume plan (E:P4). B0239 has the playful mean reproach and a closing flight question (P24, P29-P30). B0247 builds its comedy on her date, wedding, confession-anniversary and red-rice readings and on the fictional-senior reveal she delivers (505016901 P8-25; 505016902 P19-27; 505016904 P49-61; CL-B0247-025, -030, -042, -055). Each reading refuses to let the comic frame erase boundary costs. The evidence supports bounded canon questions about her play, not generation of new jokes.

Each curated unit is complete with exact native review: B0205's seven addresses, B0232's three-page message, B0239's 32-page Birthday portfolio and B0247's complete five-chapter Event family, in which she speaks in every chapter. The earlier Main and i-n-g readings the readings compare are not enrolled. B0247 elides the live and reports it only afterwards (CL-B0247-048), and the coffee outing, payment and next live are unshown. The evidence is complete for its units and narrow for the subject.

Affirmative evidence of a limitation recurs across all four readings rather than appearing once. B0205 records her admitted advice pretext (B:P1-P2), her conversion of general advice into a claimed endorsement (D:P3-P4) and a visit lost to reading (G:P1-P2). B0232 records an apology followed by continued appraisal and an invitation to observe younger members (P1-P2), which the reading treats as counterevidence to a universal-kindness reading beside Madoka's separate report. B0239 records an unlimited-touching claim met by an explicit correction, and a closing affection whose recipients flee (P23-P24, P29-P30). B0247 records an embrace against Ferb's explicit no-hug objection, a wife claim she keeps after Ferb denies it, and no shown uptake of the musical clarification (505016904 P43-48; 505016905 P15-37; CL-B0247-049, -050). These are located boundary failures, not a diagnosis. Absent counterparts' views are gaps, not further negative evidence.

The readings establish that no chronology, calendar or unlock level orders the occurrences. Local markers are relative: a recent bath and an all-day rain (B0205 A, F), a birthday located only by its distance from Miwako's and its precedence over Kajika's and Sui's (B0239 P1-P5), a festival-season live brief and a printing deadline the following morning (B0247 505016903 P0-5; 505016904 P62-68). Any claim needing date, age or sequence is unsupported.

scenario_readiness.note: Her Japanese is mostly paraphrased; located markers are a kaomoji, an address, a collective form and written comic sounds and idioms. All voice cues are unheard. B0247 supplies multi-speaker structure but little quoted wording. Generated lines would be fluent invention rather than source-supported voice. This bounds the evidence set, not Yumeno's speech.

scenario_readiness.note: The pattern is located in ten unordered occurrences, one of them a work-occasioned Event family, with mostly paraphrased speech and silent, reported or objecting counterparts. Extending it to a new situation would require inventing chronology, voice and other people's consent and answers.

Reported shopping, reading, comic work and a missed visit, two enacted preparation scenes and one received party answer bounded canon questions about these occurrences. They give no procedure for an unfamiliar ordinary situation, and others' responses to her are largely unshown.

A ranking objection, a costume restriction, an admitted pretext and two uptakes of limits (B0205 B, C, E, G; B0232 P1-P2; B0239 P23-P30) are the only normative content in evidence, and none is a weighed choice. They cannot support simulating ethical deliberation in another situation.

B0205 A's limited fantasy allowance concerns herself and is not mutual romance. B0247's date, wedding, confession and wife readings are hers; Ferb specifies musical liking, denies the wife claim and refuses the hug, and no mutual vow is shown (CL-B0247-046, -050, -055). B0232's appraisal of younger members is objectifying and is not romance. Simulating romance would require inventing counterpart consent that the evidence explicitly withholds or contradicts.

B0247 shows live preparation (costume concept, deferred song, instrument choice) and an aftermath in which Ferb values her distinctive sound, but the live itself is elided and no playing is heard (CL-B0247-047, -048). B0205's comic and B0247's manuscript are never shown, and B0239's booth question gets no answer. No rehearsal, performance or editorial process with her is shown.

known_limits.statement: The ten sources are independent conditional occurrences with no total chronology, year or unlock level; menu, catalog or execution order cannot make any occurrence a progression or reform, the chapter order of B0247 holds only inside that family, and cross-case comparisons are thematic.

The bath, the photo shop, the cloth shopping, the rainy-day reading, the missed competition, the festival-period exhaustion and the couple she followed are reported. None is enacted, and the manager's words come only through her uptake.
In B0205 D the manager's endorsement of her chosen diversion is her own conversion of general advice; he has no separately supplied line, and the intended participants give no assent.
B0232 case 21 names no particular younger member and shows no observation, inspection or manager response; the reading treats it non-graphically as stated attention and invitation only.
B0239 supplies the manager's correction that touching is not unlimited through her uptake, and her closing affection meets flight; no touch, chase or named dissenter is depicted.
In B0247 Ferb explicitly refuses the hug and protests again; earlier accommodation, the costume concept, the coffee offer and musical recognition give no general physical consent.

Her wife claim is denied by Ferb and her invoked wedding-aisle vow is not shown in the earlier dialogue; Ferb specifies that the liking concerns music, and Yumeno's uptake of that clarification is not shown.

B0247's live is omitted and reported only in its aftermath; set list, arrangement, worn costumes and playing quality are unshown, and the coffee outing, instrument payment and next live remain unrealized.
Rishuri, Ayumu, Kazumi, Rena, Kyoko, Honoka, Haru and the unnamed younger members give no turn in these occurrences; the B0239 board writers are written carriers, not present speakers.

No performed voice, laughter, music, guitar, SFX, loop movie or continuous runtime was heard or watched; B0239 leaves a loop movie unresolved and B0247 leaves command-only cues unavailable. Fixed portraits, hearts and stills are not performances.

The earlier Yumeno readings (B0093, B0131, B0168, B0169, B0174, B0183, B0202) are not curated on this subject, so the readings' comparisons with them were not checked. Missing support is not evidence of absence.

Apart from a kaomoji, an address, a collective form and written comic sounds and idioms, the readings paraphrase Yumeno's Japanese, so self-reference and sentence endings are largely absent from the curated evidence.

dimensions.note: The reading's cumulative finding is attention that is generous in valuation and self-serving in use: an objection to ranking peers' photographs (C:P3), a refusal to wear Haru's costume (E:P5) and a stated quality standard for her comic (D:P1-P2) sit beside an admitted advice pretext (B:P1-P2) and the conversion of general advice into a claimed endorsement (D:P3-P4). The cross-case pattern is sharper than a single trait, so it is graded; each address is three to five pages and no conditional rule is derived, so D is not supported.

The reading affirmatively forbids reading the seven occurrences as reform or as one calendar, and keeps F's book and G's manga, and C's and E's shopping, as separate occasions. Earlier Yumeno states (B0093-B0202) are context only and not enrolled.

A few phrases are located: accepting the old-man-inside joke (B:P3), flowers in both hands and ascension as appraisals (E), super maid-advisor (E:P3-P4), the claimed manager-approved plan (D:P4) and the self-repair from appreciating to watching the competition (G:P5). Otherwise her Japanese is paraphrased and the 31 voice cues were not heard.

Ordinary activities are reported, not shown: shopping for booklets in Akiba Seven (C), buying cloth with Rishuri and Ayumu (E), a rainy day at home with a borrowed book (F), reading a manga until dawn and oversleeping (G), and an unfinished comic for a manga-club bulletin (D). No routine is enacted.

Yumeno is the sole named speaking actor in all 31 records; the manager's compliments, advice and looks reach the reader only through her uptake, and Rishuri, Ayumu, Kazumi, Rena, Kyoko, Honoka and Haru never speak. One located differentiation (Haru's costume as hers alone, E:P5) does not support recipient conditioning.

Interior states are spoken self-reports, including an unusually direct admission of a concealed motive behind her advice role (B:P1-P2), dissatisfaction with her comic ideas (D:P1) and regret at the missed meet (G). No inward narration is distinguished from speech, and the reading does not supply her inner account in others' testimony.

Only brief, local friction is analyzed: she objects to what she reads as the manager's suspicious look and offers Kazumi as corroboration (F:P2-P3), briefly challenges his compliment (A:P3) and objects to the shop's ranking (C:P3). No escalation, sustained dispute or another person's resistance is shown.

Two stated value judgments are located: equal cuteness makes ranking unacceptable (C:P3) and Haru's exclusive costume is unthinkable for her to wear (E:P5). The reading treats both as local, and analyzes her pretext (B) and claimed endorsement (D) as appropriation without peer assent. That supports bounded canon questions about stated values, not a deliberation process.

The reading analyzes joking explicitly: suggestive amusement and a limited joking allowance (A:P2-P3), acceptance of the old-man-inside remark (B:P3), comic fitness claims (B:P4-P5) and extravagant appraisal language (E). It denies that the joking allowance transfers permission over others.

The family is complete: seven occurrences with exact scripts and hashes, all 38 native page states and 31 records read, one composite and three backgrounds viewed, and 155 context rows compared. It is still seven short addresses; the earlier readings, which the reading cites for pressure and refusal, are not enrolled, and no performed audio was reviewed.

Affirmative limits are located: the peers' assent is never supplied in A, B, D or G; the manager has no line endorsing D's plan; she cannot find a satisfying comic idea (D:P1); and she oversleeps and misses Rena's meet (G:P1-P2). The reading states that none of the independent cases is reform.
The reading establishes that no chronology, calendar or unlock level orders the occurrences, and that the meet in G is not identifiable with any earlier Rena episode.
